summary: This tutorial covers basic text alignment and formatting in LibreOffice Writer, specifically using GNU/Linux as the operating system. It explains how to align text to the left, right, or justify it within a document. The tutorial also demonstrates how to use bullets and numbering for creating lists with points and sequential numbers. To apply these features, users can select the appropriate options from the Format menu. Additionally, the tutorial shows how to indent and unindent bullet points, and how to copy and paste text within the document using keyboard shortcuts like Ctrl+C for copy and Ctrl+V for paste. Overall, the tutorial aims to make documents more visually appealing and easier to read by leveraging Writer's formatting capabilities.
